AND: Boolean conjunction. Relations bind tighter than AND, and AND tighter than OR -- the corpus wrote that shape six times and the grammar followed it (report par 10).
ARRAY: A fixed-size value array: ARRAY N OF T, with N a literal or literal CONST. Storage lives in the enclosing frame, record or module; at a call site an array lends as a SLICE.
BEGIN: Opens a body -- a procedure's or a module's. A module body is the frame with no caller: whatever it can raise, it must handle.
BY: The step of a counted loop: FOR i := a TO b BY s DO ... END.
CASE: Total dispatch. Over a scalar, arms carry literal labels (a repeated label is refused at compile time); over a CASE RECORD, every variant must have an arm or an ELSE, and pattern arms bind the payload fields.
CONST: A named literal. CONSTs are untyped and adapt exactly as the literal would -- an integer fits any width it fits, a real fits F32 or F64. Allowed at module level and inside a procedure; a local may not shadow a module CONST.
DEFINITION: Opens a DEFINITION MODULE: the contract importers see -- types, procedures with their RAISES and KEPT declarations, exceptions. Everything the reviewer needs is meant to be here.
DISPOSE: Consumes an owned pointer (its name is dead afterwards, and the checker says what killed it), or releases one handle of a SHARED pointer -- the interior is freed with the last handle. A borrow or a pool-interior pointer cannot be DISPOSEd (par 4.2, 4.3).
DIV: Integer division, truncating toward zero, checked: division by zero and MIN DIV -1 raise. Floats divide with /.
DO: Closes a loop header: WHILE cond DO, FOR ... DO.
ELSE: The remaining arm of IF or CASE.
ELSIF: A chained condition in an IF; each condition is evaluated only if the ones above failed, so a raising guard stays behind its test.
END: Closes every construct; a module's END repeats the module name.
EXCEPT: Opens the handler section of a body: arms name exceptions (| Io.IOError (p) : ...), binders receive the payload, an unmatched raise propagates to the caller.
EXCEPTION: Declares exceptions with typed payload fields: EXCEPTION SizeError (got, want: I64). RAISES may only cite declared names.
EXIT: Leaves the innermost LOOP. Refused where leaving would skip cleanup or break generated control flow (across FINALLY, inside a CASE arm) -- the refusal is loud, not silent.
FINALLY: Cleanup that runs however the block ends -- normal fall-through, RETURN, or a raise on its way out (report par 5). The C mapping is a goto chain, not setjmp.
FOR: The counted loop: FOR i := a TO b [BY s] DO ... END. Bounds are integers, evaluated once.
FROM: Imports names from a FOREIGN unit only: FROM cunit IMPORT Read, Write. m9c deliberately does not resolve a FROM target to an .m9 file -- there is none; M9 modules are imported whole with IMPORT and used qualified.
GRID: An n-dimensional array: rank in the type (GRID 2 OF F64), shape in the value, one stride per axis. Every index is checked against its own extent; VIEW drops axes; born from Mat.Get (m, 0, 3) silently answering element (1,0) of a 2x3 matrix (report par 2.2.1).
IF: IF cond THEN ... [ELSIF ...] [ELSE ...] END. The condition must be BOOL. An IS SOME binding may stand as the whole condition.
IMPLEMENTATION: Opens an IMPLEMENTATION MODULE: the bodies behind a definition. Signatures must conform to the definition exactly.
IMPORT: Brings a module into scope; its names are used qualified (Io.WriteLine). Imports come first in a module.
IN: Ties a pointer to its arena: PTR T IN pool names who owns the storage and so who frees it. A pool-interior pointer may not outlive its pool (par 4.3).
IS: The variant test that binds: IF x IS SOME p THEN ... END makes p the payload inside the arm. Legal only as the whole condition of IF, ELSIF or WHILE.
KEPT: Declared retention (par 4.1): the callee stores this parameter somewhere that outlives the call -- module state, the caller's storage, the answer. The checker computes where every store's destination escapes to and refuses an undeclared retention; the declaration composes upward the way RAISES does. The sixty-first keyword.
LOOP: The unconditioned loop; EXIT leaves it.
MODULE: A program: MODULE Name ; ... BEGIN ... END Name. Also the second word of DEFINITION MODULE and IMPLEMENTATION MODULE.
MONITOR: A record whose state is guarded by one lock. Its fields are reachable only through procedures bound to it (the bare first parameter names the monitor); a bound body holds the lock for its whole extent, and WAIT releases it while sleeping (report par 6).
NEW: Allocates from a pool: NEW (pool, T) one value, NEW (pool, T, n) a SLICE OF T, NEW (pool, T, n1, n2, ...) a GRID. Pool storage is defined-zero. The pool comes first -- reversing the arguments is refused by name.
NONE: The absent OPT value; fits any OPT type. There is no NIL to dereference -- absence is typed.
OF: Connects a former to its element: ARRAY 4 OF F64, SLICE OF CHAR, GRID 2 OF F64, CASE x OF.
OPT: A value that may be absent: OPT PTR T. It cannot be read, dereferenced or selected through without IS SOME binding the present case -- the faith-based downcast made uncompilable.
OWN: The taking parameter mode: the argument MOVES into the callee (par 4.2), and the caller's name for it is dead afterwards. Retention by transfer, visible in the signature.
POOL: An arena: allocations are carved from it and freed as one unit when it dies. Declared as a local (dies with the frame), a VAR parameter (the caller owns it), or received implicitly per call for + and string results (par 2.3). Storage is defined-zero, so an uninitialized read does not exist.
PROCEDURE: Declares a procedure. The signature carries the whole contract: parameter modes (VAR, OWN, RO, KEPT), the result, RAISES, and attributes like [PURE].
PTR: A pointer. PTR T from NEW (pool, T) is owned by exactly one binding unless the type says IN pool (the pool owns it) or SHARED (reference-counted).
RAISE: Raises a declared exception, filling its payload: RAISE SizeError (got, want). FINALLY blocks on the way out still run.
RAISES: The signature's failure list, checked exhaustively: every exception a body can produce -- its own RAISEs plus its callees' declared sets, minus what it handles -- must appear here. Overflow, IndexError and OutOfMemory are ambient and never declared.
RECORD: A record type. The CASE RECORD form declares variants with payload fields; a variant value is built with a constructor (Value.Str (x)) and taken apart only by CASE.
RETURN: Answers the caller. In a function every path must RETURN or RAISE -- the checker proves it. A string result is built in the CALLER's arena (par 2.3); a pool-interior pointer may not escape a pool that dies with the frame.
RO: The read-only borrow mode: the callee may read, may not write and may not lend onward as VAR -- for records and arrays too, where it is also the no-copy mode. Compose with KEPT when the borrow is retained.
SHARED: Reference-counted ownership: SHARED PTR T. Created explicitly -- SHARED (x) consumes the owned pointer and answers the first handle; copies count; DISPOSE releases one handle and the interior frees with the last. The count is not atomic unless the type is SHARABLE (par 6).
SIGNAL: Wakes a waiter inside a monitor.
SLICE: A view: SLICE OF T is {pointer, length}, every index checked. Also the sub-slice form SLICE (s, start, len) -- start and LENGTH, never an inclusive end -- and the array view SLICE (arr, start, len).
SOME: The present OPT: SOME (x) wraps, and IS SOME tests-and-binds.
STATEFUL: Marks a definition whose module carries state (module variables behind the interface). Plot is the corpus' example: AddLine accumulates into a module-level figure, and the definition says so.
THEN: Follows an IF or ELSIF condition.
THREAD: Starts a procedure on a new thread: THREAD (P, arg). The one argument must be SHARABLE -- a MONITOR (shared by reference, its lock is the point) or an owned value moved in. Foreign [SERIAL] procedures are serialised by an emitted per-unit monitor, so a thread reaching one waits instead of racing.
TRANSFER: Declared in the report (par 6) and not yet generated -- the honest state, stated.
TYPE: Opens a type section. Aliases chase to structure for conformance; records, monitors and opaques are nominal.
UNSAFE: Marks a unit allowed ADR and FOR-C foreign declarations. m9c --no-unsafe refuses a closure that declares one outside the trusted library directories -- the tutorial compiles strangers' code behind exactly that wall.
VAR: As a parameter mode: an exclusive, mutable borrow -- the callee may write, the caller's alias is suspended, retention still needs KEPT. As a section keyword: declares variables, defined-zero.
WAIT: Blocks inside a monitor until SIGNAL, releasing the lock while asleep.
WHILE: The tested loop: WHILE cond DO ... END. An IS SOME binding may be the condition and rebinds per iteration.
